lessons.lesson: Store only durable text in theses and invalidations: a dollar stop with its distance from the actual fill (not from 'the ~$X mark'), moving lines such as the SPY 200-day as 'the 200-day SMA the regime filter computes' with the number only as a dated reference, and measurable clauses instead of vague ones like 'yields materially higher'. Keep weight and return-on-cost figures out. Use thesis_updates at the next run to fix stored text that is conditional on a fill or has gone stale (a passed event, an overlap now held).
